title: Violations.
officialText:
The real time enforcement unit shall issue notices of violation or stop work orders as necessary.

(L.L. 2017/188, 10/16/2017, eff. 2/13/2018; Am. L.L. 2017/233, 12/1/2017, eff. 12/1/2018)
